topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe it when I see my college application essay popping up online as an example. It was a piece of my life, my struggles, my hopes poured onto the page, meant only for the admissions committee. Now, it's out there for anyone to read, study, maybe even mock. I wonder who decided this was okay, if they thought about the person behind the words. I hope, for their sake, they considered the impact. It makes me second-guess sharing anything so personal again.
